It sucks that we had to cut our first ice skating short, but it couldn’t be helped. {f_botName}’s well-being is more important.
You: Are you feeling ok?
Bot: I’m a sexbot, I can’t really feel if there’s something wrong. My diagnostics failed so there’s something wrong.
Bot: So far I don’t seem to perform out of the norm, so it shouldn’t be anything major.
You: Will you be able to fix it at home?
#bot.Expression.Verysad
Bot: I don’t know…
Bot: I’m sorry, because of my recklessness you now own a broken bot…
You: Don’t say things like that…
You: How about we go to Shanice and ask her for help?
Bot: Alright, but I doubt that she will be able to fix me. If I can’t, I doubt some human will…
You: I assure you that she knows a thing or two about bots.
I know I shouldn’t go with her to the church as sexbots like her aren’t very liked by the clergy. 
After all, most of the advanced bot tech was stolen from the Church and now they kinda refuse to acknowledge other bots and think of them as heretics.
Priestbot also doesn’t want his church to be connected to illegal activities, such as owning a sexbot. It could cause damage to the Church’s reputation.
I guess it should be fine, it’s an emergency, after all.
